checkRuns.command:
bun run build 2>&1 | tail -8; export PORT=4733 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4733 NODE_ENV=production; (bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &); sleep 3
for p in / /books /books/dracula /books/nope /zzz; do echo "== $p"; curl -s -w ' [%{http_code}]\n' localhost:4733$p | head -c 1800; echo; done
echo == POST; curl -s -i -X POST localhost:4733/contact -H "Origin: $ORIGIN" -d 'name=+Bob+&email=bad&message=short' | head -c 3000

pkill -f "kay start"; bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; (bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &); sleep 3
U=localhost:4733/_kay/action/src/routes/contact.kay/send
curl -s -X POST $U -H "Origin: $ORIGIN" -H "Referer: $ORIGIN/contact" -F 'name= Bob ' -F email=bad -F message=short -L | grep -o '<main>.*</main>'
curl -s -X POST $U -H "Origin: $ORIGIN" -H "Referer: $ORIGIN/contact" -F 'name= Bob ' -F email=a@b.co -F message=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa -L -c /tmp/cj -b /tmp/cj| grep -o '<main>.*</main>'
curl -s localhost:4733/books/nope | grep -o '<nav.*</nav>'; curl -s localhost:4733/books/dracula | grep -o '<nav.*</main>'

export PORT=4733 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4733 NODE_ENV=production
bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; echo built $?; (bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &); sleep 3
U=localhost:4733/_kay/action/src/routes/contact.kay/send
curl -s -X POST $U -H "Origin: $ORIGIN" -H "Referer: $ORIGIN/contact" -F 'name= Bob ' -F email=bad -F message=short -L | grep -o '<main>.*</main>'
curl -s -X POST $U -H "Origin: $ORIGIN" -H "Referer: $ORIGIN/contact" -F 'name= Bob ' -F email=a@b.co -F message=aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa -L -c /tmp/cj -b /tmp/cj| grep -o '<main>.*</main>'
curl -s localhost:4733/books/nope | grep -o '<nav.*</nav>'; curl -s localhost:4733/books/dracula | grep -o '<nav.*</main>'

curl -s localhost:4733/books | grep -o '<main>.*</main>' | cut -c1-1500; pkill -f "[k]ay start"; pkill -f "[s]rc/server" ; cd . && bun run fmt 2>&1 | tail -3; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3; bun run build 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|warn" ; git status --short | head -20

otherRuntimes:
cd . ; python3 - <<'E'
p='src/routes/_layout.kay'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""const section = ctx.url.pathname.split('/')[1]
""","""import { books } from '../content.config'

const [, section, slug] = ctx.url.pathname.split('/')
const inBooks = section === 'books' && (slug === undefined || slug === '' || await books.get(slug) !== undefined)
""").replace("section === 'books' ? 'page'","inBooks ? 'page'")
open(p,'w').write(s)
E

curl -s -i -X POST $U -H "Origin: $ORIGIN" -F 'name= Bob ' -F email=bad -F message=short | grep -iE '^HTTP|location|set-cookie' | cut -c1-150
curl -s -X POST $U -H "Origin: $ORIGIN" -F 'name=' -F email= -F message= -L -c /tmp/cj | grep -o '<form.*</form>'
